name: NORDWEST Handel AG
summary: Nordwest Handel AG provides procurement, finance, logistics, IT, and sales services for small and medium sized businesses in Germany and Europe. It trades in various steel products; and occupational health and safety, construction equipment and components, fittings and security products, power tools and machinery, hand tools, measuring tools and surface technology, precision tools, welding technology, technical systems, connecting technology syetems, and workshop and industrial goods. It also supplies sanitary goods and heating equipment to plumbers, fitters, and housing societies, as well as to private building owners and renovators. The company was founded in 1919 and is based in Dortmund, Germany.
